description: Remove a flag a vanilla cavalry unit has (Serpent Lord, untouched: swamp survival): #clearspec, then every other ability added back, the mount (Armored Serpent) and riding skill included.

expect.note: oracle representation, not a game change: the oracle keeps the resource size #size implies (or its game data's) in ressize, and its #clearspec drops it; in the game resource size is an ability (a265) this unit doesn't have, so its size (3) counts before and after

knownFailing: the rider's sprite without its mount is a game value (ability 1017 = 10020, read-only in vanilla.dm): #clearspec clears it and no command sets it back (#unmountedspr1 takes an image file), so the unit loses it (oracle: unmountedspr 10020 -> none). The editor should warn before removing an inherited ability or flag of a vanilla rider this way
